_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate (6% of 12h windows ±2) plus flat funding and only +6.84% 30d momentum mean no rung-change breaker is visible, so skilled default is hold inside Complacency.
next_move.brains_agree: partial split — analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency coil; narrative descriptive inflow ease without a forward phase or direction call
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed stays 45-60, funding near flat, BTC drifts without range break
next_move.invalidated_if: Funding and 30d momentum spike with Fear & Greed >70 (up) or fast selloff with F&G <40 and exchange-netflow pressure (down)
